Synthetic evaluation fixtures for the T01 tests. Not real videos or real labels;
the PMIDs are made up. Do not use these numbers for anything but tests.

The CSVs use the golden label set's schema (`research/claim-level/dataset/README.md`:
`claim_verdict`, `misinfo_basis`, `case_tags`, review fields, ...), converted from the
old `ground_truth_label` layout for T46.
